SELECT
    o.${s_topic_field} as uid,
    o.${s_mdl_dte_field} as sample_mdl_dte,
    o.uid,
    o.prv_val,
    o.os_typ,
    o.mdl_dte,
    o.lst_app_str_hr,
    o.lng_tud,
    o.lat_tud,
    o.ds,
    o.ddf_lst_app_str_tim_to_mdl_tim_sec,
    o.cty_val,
    o.alt_tud
FROM (
        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.uid,
            f.prv_val,
            f.os_typ,
            f.mdl_dte,
            f.lst_app_str_hr,
            f.lng_tud,
            f.lat_tud,
            f.ds,
            f.ddf_lst_app_str_tim_to_mdl_tim_sec,
            f.cty_val,
            f.alt_tud,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk.dwa_risk_dz_model_final_8active_device_extra_1_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
